text:
alex: Heads-up: saw a p99 latency jump ~30% on FlashAttn-v2 for seq<=32 on the paged-attention path after yesterday's kernel-selector change.
perf-bot: Regression alert: attn_latency_p99 increased 29% (baseline 120ms -> 155ms) on prod/flash-paged :warning:

maria: rough timeframe? which commit did the selector change land in?

alex: window points to the 2026-03-15 02:10 UTC deploy. Commit range a1b2c3..d4e5f6 — new rule prefers fused_flash for seq<64 when batch_size>8.

jordan: can you paste the microbench numbers / profile trace?

alex: quick paste from staging microbench:
```
seq 16, batch 16, kv=hot
- fused_flash: p50=18ms p95=44ms p99=62ms
- flash_paged: p50=12ms p95=28ms p99=38ms
```
flame snippet: fused_flash_kernel shows large memcpy/transpose samples at tail.

oliver: interesting — fused_flash still faster on avg but tail blows up. could be an extra layout copy when kv cache hits or an alignment path for small seqs.

alex: cold-kv makes p99 worse (90ms+). suspect tiled q/k layout copies that are amortized at larger seqs but expensive for short sequences and small batches.

maria: triage plan: 1) revert selector rule in canary -> measure 2) run targeted microbench hot/cold KV 3) nvprof/trace kernel ops 4) review batching split heuristics that might trigger fused path when batch has odd tail

jordan: ran a local toggle: setting use_fused_flash=false in runtime config gave p99 improvement ~25% on the same bench.

alex: command I used to reproduce:
```
tools/bench/attn_bench --kernel fused_flash --seq 16 --batch 16 --kvcache=hot --runs=100
```

perf-bot: Canary test (20% traffic) with selector reverted -> p99 back within 2% of baseline. Suggest rollback for prod.

oliver: agree. follow-up: adjust selector to consult seq distribution histogram instead of simple batch_size threshold; also add memcopy-free fused path for small seqs or fall back to flash_paged for seq<=32.

maria: assign: @alex + @jordan immediate rollback; @oliver perf follow-up + kernel patch. I'll create the incident ticket with timeline.

alex: opening PR to toggle selector default and add a flagged heuristic + perf test. PR: https://git.redwood/a/attn-kernel-selector (WIP)

jordan: will add a perf-smoke CI job that runs subsequence p50/p99 checks for seq in [8,16,32,64] on both kernels.

alex: ack, cutting the rollback patch now. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — keep updates in this thread, will coordinate release windows.
